reviews.text:
A Gentle and Effective Cleanser – My Honest Experience with ROUND LAB 1025 Dokdo Cleanser

I have been using the ROUND LAB 1025 Dokdo Cleanser for some time now, and it has quickly become a staple in my skincare routine. As someone who has sensitive and combination skin, finding a facial cleanser that strikes the perfect balance between deep cleansing and maintaining moisture has always been a challenge. Fortunately, this product delivers exceptional results and lives up to its reputation.
reviews.zh:
溫和又有效嘅洗面奶 —— 我對 ROUND LAB 1025 Dokdo Cleanser 嘅真實用後感

我已經用咗 ROUND LAB 1025 Dokdo Cleanser 一段時間，佢已經迅速成為我護膚程序入面嘅必備品。作為一個敏感肌同混合性肌嘅人，要搵到一支能夠兼顧深層清潔同保濕嘅洗面奶一直都係一個挑戰。幸運地，呢件產品效果出眾，絕對係實至名歸。

reviews.text:
The dokdo cleanser is probably one of my favorite products of all time. It foams up nicely, it cleanses gently, and leaves my skin soft like mochi. My only issue with this specific product is how awkward the bottle is. I feel like air gets into it quite quickly and feels less intuitive to use the more you use it. If you hold it up to the sun, you can see how much product you’ve used and it feels like a decent amount of product gets stuck on the top and for some reason is hard to push down. 

TLDR; love the cleanser, hate the bottle, just get the smaller bottle as its easier to get every last drop
reviews.zh:
Dokdo 潔面乳可能係我其中一款最鍾意嘅產品。佢嘅泡沫好豐富，溫和地清潔皮膚，用完之後皮膚軟滑好似麻糬咁。我對呢件產品唯一嘅投訴係個樽嘅設計好難用。我覺得好快就會有空氣入到去，用得愈耐就愈唔順手。如果你將佢對住陽光舉起，你可以睇到用咗幾多，但我覺得有唔少產品會黐住個頂，要好用力先可以唧到落去。

簡單講：鍾意支洗面奶，憎恨個樽，揀細支裝就會容易啲用到最後一滴

reviews.shade: [DOUBLE] ROUND LAB 1025 Dokdo Cleanser 200ml Double Set
reviews.text: It’s my first time trying it . It definitely cleans the skin . However I did realised that it was quite drying for my skin . I have combination skin. Definitely need a good moisturiser to pair with this cleanser especially if you use it as your primary cleanser . I think it is more suitable for people with oily skin as it dries out combination skin people like me leaving your skin feeling dry and abit itchy.
reviews.zh: 係我第一次用。佢確實可以清潔到皮膚，但係我發現用喺我塊面好乾。我係混合性肌膚。絕對需要搭返一支好嘅保濕產品一齊用，尤其係如果你用佢做主要嘅潔面產品。我覺得佢更加啱油性肌膚嘅人用，因為對我呢種混合性肌嚟講，佢會令到皮膚變得乾燥同有少少痕癢。

reviews.shade: [DOUBLE] ROUND LAB 1025 Dokdo Cleanser 200ml Double Set
reviews.text: This cleanser does an excellent job of removing dirt, oil, and makeup without stripping my skin of its natural moisture. My face feels clean and refreshed after each use. The formulation is very gentle, making it suitable for all skin types, including sensitive skin. It contains mineral-rich deep sea water from Ulleungdo, which helps to soothe and hydrate the skin. The cleanser has a creamy texture that lathers into a rich foam, providing a luxurious cleansing experience. The scent is mild and pleasant, not overpowering at all. The double pack offers great value and convenience. After using this cleanser consistently, I’ve noticed my skin feels smoother and looks clearer. It effectively balances oil production and reduces the occurrence of breakouts.
reviews.zh: 呢支洗面奶可以有效咁去除污垢、油脂同化妝品，同時唔會帶走皮膚本身嘅水分。每次用完之後塊面都覺得乾淨同煥然一新。配方好溫和，適合所有膚質，包括敏感肌都啱用。佢含有來自郁陵島嘅礦物質豐富深海海水，可以幫助舒緩同保濕皮膚。洗面奶嘅質地係 creamy，可以搓出豐富嘅泡沫，畀人一種奢華嘅潔面體驗。味道好淡好清香，完全唔會太搶。兩支裝嘅包裝好抵好方便。持續用咗一段時間之後，我發現皮膚變得更加光滑，望落都更加清澈。佢可以有效咁平衡油脂分泌，減少暗瘡爆發。

reviews.text: At first, I didn’t like this cleanser as my skin felt very sensitive after the first use. I ended up using it again in a pinch and didn’t experience the same issue, so I have been using it consistently since then. I think it is just okay. I like that it is unscented and foams up nicely, but it also takes a couple of washes to fully remove — even with using a small pea size amount. I think this causes it to be a bit stripping/drying, which can be an issue when I don’t want to do my full hydrating skincare routine after cleansing. I probably wouldn’t repurchase.
reviews.zh: 一開始我唔鍾意呢支洗面奶，因為第一次用完之後皮膚覺得好敏感。後嚟我趕住要用就再試多次，冇再出現同樣嘅問題，於是我之後就一直用住。我覺得佢只係一般。我鍾意佢冇香味同埋泡沫打得幾靚，但係要用多兩次先可以完全洗乾淨——就算只係用咗一粒豆咁多嘅量。我覺得呢樣會令到佢有少少帶走水分／乾嘅問題，喺我唔想做完整個保濕程序嘅時候就會好煩。我應該唔會再回購。

reviews.text: I love this Cleanser! It’s not stripping since it somewhat foams when water is added. And since it is not stripping, it doesn’t leave my skin feeling dry or tight like some cleanser, which sometimes is the cause of my breakout. I have been using it daily for almost three months and a little to a long way so this cleanser has lasted me awhile. I paired this with the ma:nyo Oil Cleanser when I double cleanse and I have seen a visual improvement in my skin as well as a decrease in acne breakouts. I’m almost out so I will definitely be repurchasing!
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢支洗面奶！因為佢加水之後會起少少泡，所以唔會帶走皮膚水分。正因為佢唔會帶走水分，所以用完之後皮膚唔會好似其他洗面奶咁覺得乾燥或者繃緊，而有時呢啲感覺正正就係我爆瘡嘅原因。我日日用咗差唔多三個月，用少少就已經用到好耐。我用佢配 ma:nyo 卸妝油做 double cleanse，皮膚望落有明顯改善，暗瘡都少咗。差唔多見底，所以我一定會再回購！

reviews.text:
Adoración es lo que siento por este magnífico limpiador facial. Las propiedades anti-inflamatorias del Pantenol y el extracto de manzanilla aportan una acción calmante que evitan la irritación y la reacción en mi piel sensible tras la limpieza. Contiene ácido hialurónico, butilen glicol y beta-glucano, alantoína y cerámidas, entre otros maravillosos ingredientes, los cuales suavizan mi piel, evitando la irritación y la aparición de rojeces. Su textura cremosa respeta mi piel, la hidrata, la deja limpia y fresca.
¡Ya no podría estar sin él! ¡Lo adoro! 🥰💗🥰💗🥰
reviews.zh:
對呢支優秀嘅洗面奶我只有一個感覺，就係愛。同時含有泛醇同洋甘菊萃取物嘅抗炎特性可以帶來舒緩作用，避免我塊敏感肌喺清潔之後出現敏感反應。佢含有透明質酸、丁二醇同 β-葡聚糖、尿囊素同神經醯胺等等出色嘅成分，可以令到皮膚變得柔軟，避免出現刺激同泛紅。佢 creamy 嘅質地對皮膚好溫和，可以保濕同時保持皮膚乾淨清新。
我已經唔可以冇咗佢啦！我愛死佢！🥰💗🥰💗🥰
